name: Cachesweep
soft_passes: #2 cluster bottom-right-heavy; large-sparkle anchor below/right of optical centre, reads slightly bottom-heavy at Dock size
#4 two small sparkles smear to specks at 16px; only the large sparkle survives, so it still reads as 'a sparkle'
#8 very flat: no micro-shadow under the glyph, skipping the Big Sur depth its squircle+gradient otherwise quotes
#10 no authored dark/clear/tinted Icon-Composer layers evident (single flat masked bitmap); clean silhouette would tint gracefully but variants unverified
#11 device is exactly the generic glyph-on-gradient the check warns about; nameable but stock (sparkles), communicates 'clean/magic' not 'disk/cache'

palette.background: ramp #89A0F6 (top-left light) -> #2A3AAD (bottom-right dark), midtone #4053C8, single indigo/royal-blue hue ~232

light_model: flat frontal; gradient gives a soft top-left->bottom-right luminance sweep but the white glyph is unlit with no cast/inner shadow — flatter than Big Sur's baked-micro-shadow norm
layer_stack: three flat white sparkle glyphs (SF Symbol `sparkles`)
devices: sparkle cluster (`sparkles` SF Symbol) size-cascaded small->medium->large along the ramp diagonal, so glyph motion echoes the light-to-dark sweep
monochrome-blue + single white mark, zero accent
rhymes_hint: Big Sur glyph-on-indigo-gradient utility family — stock AI-assistant icons, sparkle/broom 'freshness' cleaner utilities (CleanMyMac-adjacent), periwinkle->royal productivity squircles; seed of a probable 'indigo utility, SF-Symbol-on-ramp' icon cluster
notes: Source is a 256x256 macapp.supply web render (icon.webp), NOT the 1024 master — squircle mask and soft drop shadow are baked in with transparent corners, so full-bleed unmasked ship layers and any Icon-Composer dark/clear/tinted variants are UNVERIFIED; treat mask+shadow as the site render. Hex values sampled from the 256px bitmap, so ramp endpoints are (measured) within ~+/-3 per channel. Era is Big Sur unified language despite shipping on macOS 15+/Tahoe — no Liquid Glass layering, specular, refraction, or translucency present; #10 is therefore semi-N/A and scored as a soft pass. The icon is technically clean (12/12 craft) but template-default: the 12/12 must never travel without its 5-soft-pass asterisk. Biggest learning for synthesis: subject communication failure — sparkles reads 'magic/clean', not 'disk/cache/sweep', so it will not differentiate in a Dock of AI apps using the same symbol. Cover confirms icon<->UI palette coherence (blue wallpaper, #0A84FF-class CTA, blue menu-bar glyph).
